iteration.description: One continuously observed 600-second SecPal acceptance scenario with controller-timed CPU, memory, PostgreSQL, and private-file operations.

cpu.entitlement_observation: trusted effective affinity and cgroup quota ceiling
cpu.peak_observation: trusted controller sampling of target cgroup CPU usage
cpu.reservation_observation: trusted controller CPU-bound sibling cgroup usage over the complete iteration

memory.usable_observation: trusted effective host and target cgroup limit
memory.peak_observation: trusted target cgroup memory peak and OOM event counters
memory.reservation_observation: trusted controller allocation touched and held for the complete iteration

cycle.description: A controller-timed PostgreSQL series whose transactions write a payload, synchronously commit, read it back, and verify it, plus a POSIX private-file write/fsync/atomic-rename/directory-fsync/read/hash round trip on the qualified filesystem.
